I work on large language models and NLP. In my PhD, I want to study how LLMs can check their reasoning against evidence and update their conclusions when it changes, and how LLM agents can keep improving on new tasks without labelled data, including in low-resource languages like Bangla.

I'm an AI Researcher at Penta Global Ltd., working on Bangla medical speech recognition, prescription understanding, and agentic test-time RL. Before computing, I spent five years as a marine engineer on VLCC supertankers, where a wrong diagnosis has real consequences. That is why I care about AI systems that check their evidence. In 2023 I switched careers: I started a B.Sc. in CSE at BUBT and have kept a 4.00 CGPA while working full time.

Graduating Jan 2027 · actively seeking PhD admission (Fall 2027) in NLP & LLMs. Professors with openings — please reach out, I'd love to talk.

01 Publications

  1. BLP @ AACL
    2025

    PromptGuard at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Few-Shot Classification Framework Using Majority Voting and Keyword Similarity for Bengali Hate Speech Detection

    Rakib Hossan, Shubhashis Roy Dipta

    Proceedings of the BLP Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2025 · 2 citations

    PaperPDFCodeBibTeXScholar

    A prompt-based, few-shot framework for Bengali hate speech detection that combines LLM classification with majority voting across repeated generations and keyword-similarity signals, targeting reliable predictions in a low-resource language setting. It reaches 67.61 micro-F1, compared with 60.75 for an n-gram baseline.

2 citations · h-index 1 · synced from Google Scholar · Nov 10, 2026.

Agentic Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

Test-time RL · LLM agents · Label-free reward

From ship engine rooms to trustworthy AI

Merchant Navy · 2017 – 2023

For five years I kept the engines of VLCC super tankers running — main engines, generators, boilers — where every fault has to be traced from its symptoms back to a root cause, and a wrong call at sea has real consequences. I bring the same habit to AI research: treat model outputs as claims that need evidence, and make systems reliable before making them impressive.
